Profile.Overview: Crawl4AI Proxy for Open WebUI — bridges Open WebUI's external web loader to Crawl4AI for high-quality page content fetching.
Profile.Description:
This lightweight proxy enables Open WebUI to use Crawl4AI as its web content loader. It fetches clean markdown from any URL using Crawl4AI's headless browser with content filtering, dramatically improving the quality of web-search-enhanced AI responses.
Prerequisites: - Crawl4AI (Docker or standalone) - Open WebUI
Docker image is built locally from source. See README for build instructions.
